title: IVG Smart Max Frozen Cherry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Frozen Cherry delivers a smooth and juicy Cherry flavour backed by a cool streak of Menthol. The fruit note brings a bold, sweet character, while the chilled finish adds a crisp contrast that lifts the flavour. It's a satisfying choice for vapers who enjoy fruit with a frosty edge. Each refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a separate 10ml refill reservoir that fits directly to the pod. Once connected, the system feeds e-liquid into the pod automatically, potentially supporting up to 10,000 puffs depending on personal vaping style. Mesh coil technology ensures consistent flavour and vapour across the life of the pod. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
